# Knowledge Base Integration Test

/kb clear

/kb import tests/fixtures/kb_documents/notes1.txt

/kb import tests/fixtures/kb_documents/notes2.txt

/kb list

/kb stats

/kb search Knowledge

# --- Deterministic RAG coverage (added for v0.9.2) ---
#
# Everything above only exercised /kb import and /kb search (keyword)
# on plain .txt files. It never touched /kb ask, .docx import, or any
# of the deterministic enumeration/extraction/precise-match behavior
# built this release - meaning this check alone had zero coverage of
# the release's real changes. scripts/check_rag_behavior.sh covers
# that; scripts/regression.sh runs both together.

/kb import tests/fixtures/kb_documents/sample_contract.docx

/kb list

# Enumeration-style question - should route to the deterministic
# ExtractItems/BuildListAnswer path, zero LLM calls.
/kb ask what does the service agreement cover

# Single-fact question - should route to ExtractiveAnswer, refined by
# precise-match (findPreciseLine) down to the specific paragraph
# containing the answer, not the whole chunk.
/kb ask how much should the client pay the consultant

/kb clear

/kb list

exit
